title_en: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API With Gemini Decision 1 at $0.10/M Tokens
title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API 与 Gemini Decision 1，定价 $0.10/百万 tokens
summary_en: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1, a specialized multimodal model that scores up to 1,000 typed questions against a shared input and returns calibrated probabilities without generating text. It supports yes/no, multiple-choice, and rubric scoring question types, with a 262,144-token context and 150-250 ms end-to-end latency. On Google's benchmarks, it leads 7 of 9 accuracy tests, achieves 92.2% on JevBench and the lowest calibration error (0.0250 ECE), but trails TypeSafe Jev 1.14 on When2Call (79.9% vs 82.0%) and costs more per token ($0.10 vs $0.042). Priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output token billing, it is available via the Gemini Developer API (v1beta).
summary_zh: Google 发布了由 Gemini Decision 1 驱动的 Gemini Decisions API，该专用多模态模型不生成文本，而是针对共享输入对最多 1,000 个结构化问题打分并返回校准概率。它支持是/否、多选和评分三种问题类型，上下文长度为 262,144 tokens，端到端延迟 150-250 毫秒。在 Google 的基准测试中，它在 9 项准确率测试中领先 7 项，JevBench 达到 92.2%，校准误差最低（ECE 0.0250），但在 When2Call 上落后于 TypeSafe Jev 1.14（79.9% vs 82.0%），且每 token 成本更高（$0.10 vs $0.042）。定价为每百万输入 tokens $0.10，输出 tokens 不计费，可通过 Gemini Developer API（v1beta）使用。
content_en:
Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by a new model, Gemini Decision 1 (`gemini-decision-1`). The Gemini Decisions API does not generate text. It scores up to 1,000 typed questions against one shared input and returns calibrated probabilities. For developers, this targets the small branching calls inside agents: routing, policy checks, tool selection and grading. Google prices it at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with zero output tokens billed.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** Context is 262,144 tokens (256K) across shared input and all questions.
- **Runs on:** Google-hosted API only (Gemini Developer API, v1beta). No open weights or self-hosting.
- **Performance:** Leads 7 of 9 accuracy benchmarks in Google’s table, with the lowest calibration error.
- **Best:** 92.2% on JevBench (public split).
- **Worst:** 58.7% Macro-F1 on Amazon ESCI, its lowest score. It also trails Jev 1.14 on When2Call (79.9% vs 82.0%).
- **Bottom line:** Best: multimodal, calibrated decisions in 150-250 ms. Worst: not the cheapest; Jev 1.14 costs $0.68 vs $0.88 on the shared suite.

## **What is the Gemini Decisions API?**

Gemini Decision 1 is a specialized multimodal model from Google built for closed-set decisions. It reads text, images, video, audio and PDFs in one prefill pass. Output token usage is always 0. Your code branches directly on the returned numbers.

Each request has 3 parts: a model ID, a shared `input`, and a map of questions. **The docs define 3 question types:**

- **`noul` (yes/no):** returns the probability of yes, bounded between 0.01 and 0.99.
- **`choice`:** picks 1 of 2 to 255 options and returns normalized probabilities for every option.
- **`score`:** rates input on 2 to 255 ordered rubric levels and returns a probability-weighted score.

Every answer carries a confidence value from 0 to 1. Google suggests routing low-confidence cases to a fallback or a human reviewer. Questions are scored in parallel and cannot see each other.

## **How does Gemini Decision 1 work?**

Standard models decode an answer token by token, then your code parses it. Gemini Decision 1 instead scores your candidate options in one forward pass. Google reports median model compute of 50-100 ms and 150-250 ms end to end. That holds for inputs up to 16K tokens and stays nearly flat from 1 to 100 questions.

Billing follows the same design. The shared input is billed once per request, however many questions you ask. Each question adds only its own instruction and criteria tokens. There are no thinking-token, transcription or OCR charges.

## **Gemini Decision 1 benchmarks**

Google tested Gemini Decision 1 against 3 rivals. They are TypeSafe Jev 1.14, GPT-6 Luna on OpenAI Decisions and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. All figures below are self-reported by Google. Refusals and safety blocks count as incorrect.

| Benchmark | Gemini Decision 1 | TypeSafe Jev 1.14 | GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions) | Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JevBench (public split) | **92.2%** | 90.0% | 90.9% | 86.6% | 
| Amazon ESCI (Macro-F1) | **58.7%** | 56.7% | 54.7% | 47.2% | 
| New Yorker Caption (text-only) | **79.7%** | 72.0% | 68.4% | 73.7% | 
| Mind2Web Multimodal | 86.2% | **86.8%** | 81.8% | 78.0% | 
| PubMedQA | **79.8%** | 78.2% | 74.4% | 77.6% | 
| Global-MMLU-Lite (non-English) | **86.0%** | 85.0% | 79.6% | 78.8% | 
| When2Call | 79.9% | **82.0%** | 70.4% | 60.9% | 
| MMAU (audio) | **71.8%** | Not reported | Not reported | 67.7% | 
| Video-MME (no subtitles) | **69.1%** | Not reported | Not reported | 63.3% | 
| Top-1 ECE (lower is better) | **0.0250** | 0.0494 | 0.0721 | 0.2104 | 
| Total price, 7 shared evals | $0.88 | **$0.68** | $0.93 | $4.14 | 

**Source:** Google blog benchmark table.

The calibration result is the clearest gap. Gemini Decision 1’s error of 0.0250 is about half of Jev 1.14’s 0.0494. That matters when you set confidence thresholds for automation. On cost, Google says it is nearly 5x cheaper than Flash-Lite across the shared suite ($0.88 vs $4.14).

## **Gemini Decisions API vs OpenAI Decisions vs TypeSafe Jev**

| Feature | Gemini Decision 1 | GPT-6 Luna, OpenAI Decisions | TypeSafe Jev 1.14 | 
|---|---|---|---|
| Parameters | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 
| Context | 262,144 tokens | 1,050,000 (model page) | 64K per request, 262K with opt-in header | 
| Questions per request | 1 to 1,000 | 1 to 400 | No fixed cap, bounded by context | 
| Input modalities | Text, image, audio, video, PDF | Text, image, JSON | Text (docs) | 
| Input price per 1M tokens | $0.10 | $0.10 uncached | $0.042 | 
| Output price | $0 | $0 | $0 | 
| Prompt caching | Not supported | Supported, charged at Luna rates | Not disclosed | 
| Latency claim | 150-250 ms end to end | About 10x faster than Responses API | Not disclosed | 

## **How to deploy the Gemini Decisions API**

The endpoint is live on the Gemini Developer API (v1beta) and needs `google-genai` SDK 3.2 or later. A no-cost tier is available for prototyping in Google AI Studio. Python, JavaScript and REST guides are in the documentation.

Ecosystem support is rolling out across OpenRouter, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, LiteLLM, Pydantic AI, Pipecat, LiveKit and OpenCode. Support in Gemini on Google Cloud is listed as coming soon.

Google already uses it internally. Gemini Notebook routes queries to model tiers with it, serving everyday queries with up to 40% lower latency. Google Labs’ CC picks emoji reactions from more than 200 options. Stitch’s rapid canvas uses it to build playable wireframes in seconds.

## **Key Takeaways**

- Gemini Decision 1 scores up to 1,000 questions per call with zero output tokens.
- It reads text, images, audio, video and PDFs natively in 1 pass.
- Calibration error of 0.0250 is half that of TypeSafe Jev 1.14.
- At $0.10/M input tokens, it still costs more than Jev’s $0.042/M.
- No caching or Batch API yet, so repeated context is billed in full.

content_zh:
Google 推出了 Gemini Decisions API，由新模型 Gemini Decision 1（`gemini-decision-1`）驱动。Gemini Decisions API 不生成文本。它针对一个共享输入对最多 1,000 个带类型的问题进行评分，并返回经过校准的概率。对开发者而言，这面向的是智能体内部的小型分支调用：路由、策略检查、工具选择和评分。Google 将其定价为每 100 万输入 token 0.10 美元，输出 token 不计费。

## **TL;DR**

- **规模：** 上下文为 262,144 个 token（256K），覆盖共享输入和所有问题。
- **运行方式：** 仅限 Google 托管的 API（Gemini Developer API，v1beta）。没有开放权重或自托管。
- **性能：** 在 Google 的表格中领先 9 项准确率基准中的 7 项，并具有最低的校准误差。
- **最佳：** 在 JevBench（公开拆分）上达到 92.2%。
- **最差：** 在 Amazon ESCI 上 Macro-F1 为 58.7%，是其最低分。它在 When2Call 上也落后于 Jev 1.14（79.9% 对 82.0%）。
- **结论：** 最佳之处：在 150-250 毫秒内完成多模态、经校准的决策。最差之处：并非最便宜；在共享套件上，Jev 1.14 的成本为 0.68 美元，而其为 0.88 美元。

## **什么是 Gemini Decisions API？**

Gemini Decision 1 是 Google 推出的专用多模态模型，专为闭集决策构建。它在一次预填充过程中读取文本、图像、视频、音频和 PDF。输出 token 用量始终为 0。你的代码直接根据返回的数值进行分支。

每个请求包含 3 个部分：模型 ID、共享的 `input` 以及问题映射。**文档定义了 3 种问题类型：**

- **`noul`（是/否）：** 返回“是”的概率，限定在 0.01 到 0.99 之间。
- **`choice`：** 从 2 到 255 个选项中选择 1 个，并返回每个选项的归一化概率。
- **`score`：** 按 2 到 255 个有序评分等级对输入进行评分，并返回概率加权分数。

每个答案都带有 0 到 1 的置信度值。Google 建议将低置信度案例路由到回退方案或人工审核员。问题并行评分，且彼此不可见。

## **Gemini Decision 1 如何工作？**

标准模型逐 token 解码答案，然后由你的代码解析。Gemini Decision 1 则相反，在一次前向传播中对候选选项进行评分。Google 报告模型计算时间中位数为 50-100 毫秒，端到端为 150-250 毫秒。这对于最多 16K token 的输入成立，并且在 1 到 100 个问题之间几乎保持平稳。

计费遵循同样的设计。无论你提出多少问题，共享输入每个请求只计费一次。每个问题仅增加其自身的指令和标准 token。没有思考 token、转录或 OCR 费用。

## **Gemini Decision 1 基准**

Google 将 Gemini Decision 1 与 3 个竞争对手进行了测试。它们是 TypeSafe Jev 1.14、OpenAI Decisions 上的 GPT-6 Luna 以及 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite。以下所有数据均由 Google 自行报告。拒绝和安全拦截计为错误。

| 基准测试 | Gemini Decision 1 | TypeSafe Jev 1.14 | GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions) | Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JevBench（公开集） | **92.2%** | 90.0% | 90.9% | 86.6% |
| Amazon ESCI（Macro-F1） | **58.7%** | 56.7% | 54.7% | 47.2% |
| New Yorker Caption（纯文本） | **79.7%** | 72.0% | 68.4% | 73.7% |
| Mind2Web Multimodal | 86.2% | **86.8%** | 81.8% | 78.0% |
| PubMedQA | **79.8%** | 78.2% | 74.4% | 77.6% |
| Global-MMLU-Lite（非英语） | **86.0%** | 85.0% | 79.6% | 78.8% |
| When2Call | 79.9% | **82.0%** | 70.4% | 60.9% |
| MMAU（音频） | **71.8%** | 未报告 | 未报告 | 67.7% |
| Video-MME（无字幕） | **69.1%** | 未报告 | 未报告 | 63.3% |
| Top-1 ECE（越低越好） | **0.0250** | 0.0494 | 0.0721 | 0.2104 |
| 7 项共享评测的总价格 | $0.88 | **$0.68** | $0.93 | $4.14 |

**来源：** Google 博客基准测试表。

校准结果是最明显的差距。Gemini Decision 1 的误差为 0.0250，约为 Jev 1.14 的 0.0494 的一半。当你为自动化设置置信度阈值时，这一点很重要。在成本方面，Google 表示在共享套件上它比 Flash-Lite 便宜近 5 倍（$0.88 对 $4.14）。

## **Gemini Decisions API vs OpenAI Decisions vs TypeSafe Jev**

| 特性 | Gemini Decision 1 | GPT-6 Luna, OpenAI Decisions | TypeSafe Jev 1.14 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 参数量 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 |
| 上下文 | 262,144 tokens | 1,050,000（模型页面） | 每请求 64K，启用 opt-in header 后 262K |
| 每请求问题数 | 1 到 1,000 | 1 到 400 | 无固定上限，受上下文限制 |
| 输入模态 | 文本、图像、音频、视频、PDF | 文本、图像、JSON | 文本（文档） |
| 每 1M tokens 输入价格 | $0.10 | $0.10（未缓存） | $0.042 |
| 输出价格 | $0 | $0 | $0 |
| 提示缓存 | 不支持 | 支持，按 Luna 费率计费 | 未披露 |
| 延迟声明 | 端到端 150-250 ms | 比 Responses API 快约 10 倍 | 未披露 |

## **如何部署 Gemini Decisions API**

该端点已在 Gemini Developer API（v1beta）上线，需要 `google-genai` SDK 3.2 或更高版本。Google AI Studio 提供免费层级用于原型开发。文档中包含 Python、JavaScript 和 REST 指南。

生态系统支持正在 OpenRouter、LangChain、Vercel AI SDK、LiteLLM、Pydantic AI、Pipecat、LiveKit 和 OpenCode 上逐步推出。Google Cloud 上的 Gemini 支持列为即将推出。

Google 已在内部使用它。Gemini Notebook 使用它将查询路由到模型层级，使日常查询的延迟降低最多 40%。Google Labs 的 CC 从 200 多个选项中挑选表情符号反应。Stitch 的快速画布使用它在几秒内构建可玩的线框图。

## **关键要点**

- Gemini Decision 1 每次调用最多可评分 1,000 个问题，且输出 tokens 为零。
- 它可在 1 次处理中原生读取文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF。
- 0.0250 的校准误差是 TypeSafe Jev 1.14 的一半。
- 按 $0.10/M 输入 tokens 计算，它仍然比 Jev 的 $0.042/M 更贵。
- 目前尚无缓存或 Batch API，因此重复上下文会按全额计费。
